nodes.label: LightConstants.glsl (shared C++/GLSL header)
nodes.rationale: Preprocessor-only header included by both SceneLights.hpp and CookTorrance.frag so the light-type tags, array bounds and debug bits have exactly one definition instead of two kept in step by hand.

nodes.label: Dynamic cube-shadow slot pool
nodes.rationale: There are more shadow-worthy point lights than cube slots, so slots are handed out at runtime to whichever lights are nearest the player rather than at load time; no light gets a permanent slot merely for being implemented first.

nodes.label: Per-stage sampled-image budget as the real ceiling
nodes.rationale: Cubes plus 2D maps plus the albedo map share the fragment stage's sampled-image budget and now exceed Vulkan's guaranteed minimum of 16, a deliberate trade: real desktop GPUs allow far more, and the dynamic pool degrades gracefully rather than breaking.

nodes.label: debugFlags bitmask for shading cheats
nodes.rationale: One int rather than a field per switch: the views are independent and combine, the names live next to LIGHT_DIRECT/POINT/SPOT so C++ and GLSL read the same bits, and it fits in std140 padding so the uniform does not grow.

nodes.label: One header shared between C++ and GLSL
nodes.rationale: Constants written twice with a comment asking the reader to keep them in step is not a mechanism: change one side and the C++ struct and GLSL block silently stop describing the same bytes. Works because the file is preprocessor-only, the one syntax both languages agree on.
